title: The Outsider
author: Stephen King
summary: A boy is found murdered in a small Oklahoma town, and all the evidence points to a well-liked coach. Yet he also has solid proof that he was elsewhere. A detective must figure out how both can be true.
readIf: you like King when he blends a police procedural with the supernatural, and enjoy a slow build of dread.
skipIf: you would find a murdered child and graphic descriptions upsetting, as the opening is disturbing.

pairings.reason: A classic about investigating a monstrous killer, with the same procedural focus.
Another King story of a small town infiltrated by something evil and the few who see it.
A faster, plot-driven hunt for a killer, with fewer supernatural elements.
